title: AttributeError when parsing
body:
Originally reported by: **Luca Wehrstedt (BitBucket: [lerks](http://bitbucket.org/lerks), GitHub: @lerks?)**

---

With the following snippet:

```
#!python

with open("") as a.b:
    c.d()
    c = None
```

